item.title: TEKO TURBOLITE
item.description: Compact golf cart available in 2-seat and 2+2 configurations with golf bag mounts, scorecard clip, golf ball holder, 5 kW AC motor, and 51.2V LiFePO4 battery.

item.title: TEKO TURBO
item.description: Flexible 2+2 electric golf cart with front and rear cargo compartments, side console storage, CarPlay, Android Auto, and HD rear-view camera.

item.title: TEKO TROPHY
item.description: Refined four-seat electric vehicle with 5 kW AC motor, lithium battery, premium sound, LED lighting, touchscreen, and HD rear-view camera.

item.title: TEKO TRIUMPH
item.description: Lifted six-seat electric vehicle with 1,300+ lb hauling capacity, 30% grade climbing, independent shocks, all-terrain tires, and premium seating.

item.title: TEKO TROPHY PLUS
item.description: Six-seat utility-focused electric vehicle with adaptive suspension, front and rear cargo storage, fold-down cargo platform, and 1,300+ lb hauling capacity.
